{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for any imbalance in customer_segment or customer_age between channels
# Cross-tabulate channel with customer_segment
crosstab_segment = pd.crosstab(df['channel'], df['customer_segment'])
print('Cross-tabulation: customer_segment by channel')
print(crosstab_segment)

# Check for imbalance in customer_age
print('\nMean customer_age by channel:')
print(df.groupby('channel')['customer_age'].mean())

# Check for imbalance in status
print('\nStatus distribution by channel:')
print(pd.crosstab(df['channel'], df['status']))"}
